episodes.synopsis: The outbreak starts while you are inside a Home Depot. You lock the doors, chain the carts, never run the chainsaw, and grab water, rope and a crowbar. At nine the power dies, then a police radio says go to the base while the base speakers say stay back and go to the station.
episodes.cliffhanger: Do you run to the half-dark police station across the street, or the guarded military base two miles away?
